city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula supporting an expectant mom in San Marcos: Texas Hill Country birth support and doula care
city_fields.culture: San Marcos sits on the San Marcos River in the Texas Hill Country, about 30 miles south of Austin and 45 miles northeast of San Antonio. Home to Texas State University, the city blends a lively college town with a fast-growing family community. Birth care here runs the gamut — from CHRISTUS Santa Rosa Hospital - San Marcos's Level II NICU and Level II Maternal Care designation to licensed midwives offering home and birth center births, and a growing community of birth doulas serving Hays County.
city_fields.medicaidNote: No — Texas does not yet have statewide Medicaid doula coverage as of 2026. Some managed-care pilots and health plans offer limited doula benefits, but most San Marcos families pay out of pocket for doula support. Call your Medicaid managed-care plan and ask directly whether doula services are covered, or call Texas Medicaid at 1-877-543-7669 and visit YourTexasBenefits.com.
